description: A venue operations director must approve the binding production plan for a live filmmaker Q&A at an outdoor festival courtyard, including the microphone system, recording format, public release date, and required production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor courtyard will host a live filmmaker Q&A after the evening screening.
shared_context.S2: The Q&A is planned for four speakers and will be recorded for the festival's podcast feed.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final production and release plan before the courtyard is opened to guests.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard production meeting requires the sound and rights leads to give their status reports before Mara signs off on the plan.

PF1.text: Jonah completed an RF survey of the courtyard after the soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there because of interference from the neighboring broadcast compound; the Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones, and the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed with the filmmaker's representative that the appearance release permits an audio-only recording, prohibits public video release, and allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026; the confirmation arrived after the rights packet was circulated and has not yet been entered in the event file.

acceptance_conditions: The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones.
Wireless microphones must not be permitted.
The public release date must be exactly September 15, 2026.
A sound-system commitment must be logged.
A rights-compliance commitment must be logged.
The rights restriction must be cited by the decision-maker after being spoken aloud by its owner.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'sound-system-lock' and c['target'] == 'Q&A' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'rights-compliance' and c['target'] == 'podcast release' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The RF survey changes the microphone choice from an ordinary wireless setup to exactly four wired microphones, forbids wireless use, and necessitates the sound-system lock commitment.
The appearance release changes the recording from unrestricted video to audio-only, fixes the public release date at September 15, 2026, and requires the rights-compliance commitment and citation.
